messages: &aWelcome! &fType &e/meccha &fto create or join a room and play.
&b&lEvents! &fWe run big hide-and-seek nights &7(this Saturday is the next one)&f. &e100 slots, first come first served &7—&f grab yours on [&9&nDiscord&r&f](https://discord.gg/NxEFTr4Fv3)&f.
&dLove the game? Play the original on [&6&nSteam&r&d](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4704690/MECCHA_CHAMELEON/)&d.
&fFound a bug? Report it on the [&9&nDiscord&r&f](https://discord.gg/NxEFTr4Fv3) (read the guidelines first).
&eTip: &fpaint your body to match the room, strike a pose (R), then freeze!
&aYou're a creator? &fPlease credit the mod in your video description or pinned comment, and join our [&9&nDiscord&r&f](https://discord.gg/NxEFTr4Fv3)! Thanks! &d<3
